summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. The deal closed on May 13, 2026, as per the Merger Agreement dated January 11, 2026. Each Sun Country share was converted into $4.10 cash plus 0.1557 shares of Allegiant common stock. The merger was effected through two successive mergers, with Sun Country becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. The board's recommendation and advisor are not named in this excerpt. This is a cash-and-stock deal with a structural two-step merger. Watch for integration execution and potential stock price adjustments.
